Hadur 2 2.0-SNAPSHOT API

Packages
Package
Description
hadur.bench
 
hadur2
The Robocode adapter: the only code in Hadur 2 that sees the engine.
hadur2.core
Hadur 2's core: the whole of the robot's strategy, as plain Java that never sees the Robocode engine.
hadur2.core.adapt
Recognise, then adapt (S4): the opening book that turns a loaded profile into decisions for the first tick (ADAPT-1, ADAPT-2), the seeds it replays into the KNN views at a lower weight (ADAPT-3), and the trust that fades those seeds when the opponent no longer behaves like its profile (RES-4).
hadur2.core.duel
 
hadur2.core.gun
The duel's gun: two KNN guns, the virtual guns that rate them, and the choice between them.
hadur2.core.knn
K-nearest-neighbour learning shared by the duel's gun and movement: a weighted KD-tree and the views built on it.
hadur2.core.ledger
The energy ledger: deciding which of the enemy's energy drops are bullets (WAVE-1, WAVE-2).
hadur2.core.link
The link (A4): teammates' reports as bytes, in the core's own versioned, checksummed format (LINK-1).
hadur2.core.melee
Melee (free-for-all) subsystems: opponent tracking, sweep radar, minimum-risk movement, target selection, circular targeting and posture strategy, and each opponent's melee profile block (MMEM-1), driven each tick by MeleeController.
hadur2.core.memory
Opponent memory (stage S3): one OpponentProfile per opponent lineage, folded from each round's observations (MEM-2), encoded in a small checksummed binary format (ProfileCodec) and kept in a ProfileStore by the ProfileLibrary (MEM-1, MEM-3 to MEM-5, RES-3).
hadur2.core.model
The values the core is made of: what crosses the hexagonal boundary each tick, the robot states and their logs, and the waves the duel's gun and movement learn from.
hadur2.core.move
The duel's movement: wave surfing against the enemy's bullets, the danger views it scores with, and the shadows our own bullets cast on the enemy's waves.
hadur2.core.physics
The engine's physics and the geometry built on it: the bottom layer that the duel's gun, surf, waves and energy ledger, and the melee brain, all stand on.
hadur2.core.policy
Aggressive (S5): the policies that decide how close Hadur fights and how hard it shoots.
hadur2.core.port
The core's outbound ports: the only ways it reaches anything outside plain computation.
hadur2.core.replay
Recorded battles as text, and a driver that replays them through a fresh core (CORE-2).
hadur2.core.role
The role contract's routing (A1 of the architecture evolution, ROLE-1 to ROLE-4): which strand drives the robot this tick.
hadur2.core.shield
Bullet shielding: noticing an enemy that shoots our bullets down, and aiming so it can't.
hadur2.core.shieldmode
Hadur's own bullet shield (D5): on the opponents of a list of Hadur's own it opens each round sitting still and shoots the enemy's bullets down.
hadur2.core.world
